text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 多题材场景60组 · 10 · 悬空树根图书庭院.
Environment:  A quiet open-air library courtyard on a floating island, a huge old tree's roots gently wrapping pale stone book niches and arched walls, covered shelves of blank-spined books, simple warm wooden reading bench, glimpses of clouds through broken outer arches. Grass and tiny flowers between stones. Original sky-civilization design, no people, animals, faces or inscriptions.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent multi-angle image sheet with 3 clearly separated views of the same location. Show complementary eye-level views and relevant close details. Maintain the same physical positions of entrances, windows, stairs, furniture and landmark objects across views; no mirrored rearrangement. Small A/B/C/D labels only.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Edit the reference contact sheet. Preserve panels A and B exactly. Replace panel C with a close detail view looking at the SAME giant tree roots on the LEFT side of this courtyard and the adjacent book shelves. Do not show a new reverse overview. Maintain same architecture, tree, cream stone, warm light. Relayout three equal panels A B C in landscape format. Empty environment, no people or animals. Only C changes; no scene mirroring.
